vi. 重复利用","audio":"recycle.mp3"},{"word":"redundant","pronun":"[rɪˈdʌndənt]","translation":"adj. 多余的，过剩的；被解雇的，失业的；冗长的，累赘的","audio":"redundant.mp3"},{"word":"reel","pronun":"[riːl]","translation":"n. 蹒跚；眩晕；旋转
